title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
key_facts: Google said Thursday (15 Oct 2026) that Universal Cart is available to US users.
It was first previewed at Google I/O in May.
It collects and monitors products from Search and the Gemini app, across multiple retailers.
Notifications for price drops and restocks.
Can take credit card perks into account and surface promo codes.
Checkout is tied to the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), an open standard Google introduced earlier this year.
TechCrunch says Amazon, OpenAI and others have added agentic shopping features too.
quote_evidence: Google on Thursday said "Universal Cart," a tool that lets users collect and monitor products they find across search and in the Gemini app, is now available to U.S. users.
The company first previewed the tool at Google I/O in May.
why_it_matters_hint: A mainstream shopping tool from the biggest search engine moves AI agent checkout toward the mainstream.
notes: Launch is today; the May preview is background.
